parameters.zhPrompt: 奶油米色调以暖象牙白、燕麦色和浅杏色统一背景与中间调，黑位略抬、对比柔和但主体边缘仍清楚；肤色保持红黄平衡，白物不染成脏黄，木材和织物保留天然层次，避免全片米黄罩染或灰雾低反差
parameters.enPrompt: cream-beige grade unifying backgrounds and midtones through warm ivory oatmeal and pale apricot, with slightly lifted blacks and gentle contrast while subject edges remain legible; skin keeps balanced red and yellow, white objects do not turn dirty cream and wood or fabric retain natural separation, avoiding an all-over beige cast or hazy flatness

parameters.zhPrompt: 雪景清蓝调色保护雪面高光层次，让阳面保持中性白，阴影转为清澈淡蓝并随坡度加深；天空和远山降低杂色，树木与建筑暗部仍有细节，整体空气冷而不偏青紫，避免雪地灰脏、纯白剪切或统一蓝色滤镜
parameters.enPrompt: clean snow-blue grade protecting highlight texture across snow so sunlit planes stay neutral white while shadows shift to clear pale blue and deepen with slope; sky and distant mountains lose color noise while trees and buildings retain dark detail, creating cold air without cyan-purple contamination, dirty gray snow clipped whites or a uniform blue filter

parameters.zhPrompt: 婚礼柔光调色以明亮中高调和柔和高光滚降保护婚纱蕾丝、白花与肤色细节，阴影略抬但保留礼服层次；肤色温润中性，绿色和宴会杂色适度收敛，可有轻微柔光晕而不降低对焦清晰度，避免过曝白纱和粉色蒙层
parameters.enPrompt: soft wedding grade using bright high-key midtones and gentle highlight roll-off to protect lace white flowers and skin detail while slightly opening shadows without flattening formalwear; skin remains warm-neutral and distracting greens or venue colors are restrained, with a faint bloom that does not reduce focus, avoiding blown bridal whites or a pink veil

parameters.zhPrompt: 人物修图自然减淡过深颈纹的阴影和局部色差，只降低突兀对比，不抹平正常转头褶皱、颈部肌理、锁骨与受光结构；纹理频率与面部保持一致，避免横向涂抹、重复修补纹路或把颈部变成无结构塑料表面
parameters.enPrompt: portrait retouch naturally softening excessive shadow and discoloration in prominent neck lines by reducing abrupt contrast only; preserve pose-related folds skin texture collarbones and lighting structure with texture frequency matching the face, avoiding horizontal smears repeated healing patterns or a structureless plastic neck

parameters.zhPrompt: 动作残影特效沿真实运动方向排列少量连续轮廓，起始影像较淡、当前主体最清楚，间距随速度变化并保持肢体动作顺序；残影透明但边缘可辨，不重复背景或静止部位，避免整画面拖影、随机复制人物和方向矛盾
parameters.enPrompt: motion-afterimage effect placing a limited sequence of readable silhouettes along the true movement path, with earlier phases fainter and the current subject sharpest, spacing changing with speed while limb order remains coherent; echoes stay translucent without duplicating background or stationary parts, avoiding full-frame smear random clones or contradictory direction
